coordinate_policy: Frozen source640x360 atlas; exact integer width/height scaling; raw y reversal only. No resize, translation, alternate crop, tolerance or threshold tuning.
failure_scope: Ordinary failure saves validation/error where possible; a structure no-pass/ambiguity is an analysis result, not an exception or repair. No semantic extraction until independent review confirms valid direction and lane contract.
flat_regions: All10 frozen patch interiors must each contain exactly one distinct complete8byte pixel tuple.
format_scope: Raw bytes only for structure; no RGB interpretation, expected color, host similarity or PNG-output fitting selects direction.

parser_revision.scope: Only standard source PNG filtering support; previous source-parser premise failed before any snapshot raw read. Exact tuple geometry and raw gates unchanged.

ramp_marker_rule: All rows of a band bit-identical across full band; in each of5 predeclared patch-interior x bins, first row contains at least2 distinct complete pixel tuples. All3 bands evaluated; only band index2 may satisfy this ramp marker.
raw_gate: Each13/14 named/custom raw is independently tested in both directions. A direction is selected iff exactly1 candidate passes; otherwise unknown, without retries or relaxed gates.
source_gate: Both SHA-locked source RGBA16BE PNGs decoded losslessly; PNG CRC/IHDR/standard lossless filters0..4/exact length guarded. Source top-down must pass structure; bottom-up must fail; decoded active pixel bytes of the2 source PNGs must match.
